title: Tab Panel ID
prompt: A React tabs component needs matching ids for panels. Write a helper that returns "panel-" followed by the tab id.

explanation.beginner:
Example: tabPanelId("settings") produces "panel-settings". The result must follow this precise rule: A React tabs component needs matching ids for panels. Write a helper that returns "panel-" followed by the tab id. Work with one argument at a time and distinguish the values that select a branch from the values returned by that branch.

Compare “keeps numeric text”: input ["2"] produces "panel-2". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:

Trace the branch conditions and any accumulator or lookup after each input. Keep the return contract separate from how it is calculated.
